  - Two ring hydrogens remain because positions 2 and 4 are substituted.
- **Thiophene-2-sulfonamide:** SO₂NH  
  - Adds **S₁O₂N₁H₁**.
- **[(2,2-dimethylcyclopropyl)methyl] substituent:** C₆H₁₁  
  - Cyclopropane C₃, two methyl groups C₂, and methylene linker C₁.
- **[(cyclopropylamino)methyl] substituent:** C₄H₈N  
  - Methylene linker C₁H₂, amino nitrogen NH, and cyclopropyl C₃H₅.
